profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer. 12 years of experience in embedded systems.
profile.summary: Fast learner who has repeatedly demonstrated proficiency applying software engineering problem solving strategies in team environments for a variety of different fields. Strong skills in areas such as object oriented design, dataflow and real time debugging in many languages such as C, C++, Visual Basic and Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for Class 2 medical device manufacturing systems in Visual Basic and Python. Major responsibilities include configuration management for variations in products and device hardware, optimizing manufacturing test performance and addressing quality issues.
Integration of manufacturing software and analysis tools with MS SQL database to manage manufacturing workflow and track performance, quality and business insights.
Embedded C development of Bluetooth Low Energy test fixture.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software development for a Class 2 medical device used for fluidic diagnostics. Major responsibilities included making improvements to diagnostic and calibration processes, developing firmware to exercise hardware functions as part of manufacturing validation process, improvements to debug information collected by firmware.
Development of GUI tools for R&D and manufacturing use with Visual C#.
Unit testing of C code with ceedling.
Implementation of static analysis with SonarQube.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software development for a Class 3 medical device. Major projects include developing a CAN driver and refactoring GUI firmware.
Unit Testing.
Design reviews as well as code reviews.

positions.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Developing major software components for advanced electric vehicle charging technology in C. These include CAN, UART and WiFi stack components.
Design of embedded software components.
Unit testing of embedded C software components.
Integration testing of embedded system with multiple processors, external connections.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software design for real time industrial control systems (Integrity RTOS, FreeRTOS).
Debugging real time embedded systems.
Designing application software to interface with industrial control systems.
Writing technical specifications and test cases.
Performing and analyzing tests of industrial control hardware and software.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Using emulator debug, bus analysis, experimentation and data analysis to find firmware root causes of Hard Disc Drive performance degrades and functional problems with customer configurations.
Making code changes to improve drive performance and fix bugs and analyzed the positive impact and associated risks.
Data analysis to understand patterns and root causes of hard drive workload performance issues.

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Improving software for pressure sensor step response test including fixing calculation errors, adding excel charting capability and improving ease use use.
Performing and documenting various tests of industrial measurement devices and software

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Experimenting with capabilities of TI CC2541 Bluetooth System-on-Chip.
Performing, analyzing and improving test procedures.
Researching, comparing and procuring devices including microprocessors, sensors and display components.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Analyzing and debugging electronic circuit designs.
Writing test scripts.
Reworking Printed Circuit Boards with surface mount and thru-hole soldering.

positions.title: Systems Quality Assurance Co-op
positions.description:
Programming Arduino to test GPIO hardware and integrating it into test software.
Developing webpage for automated test reporting using HTML, javascript and PHP.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Researching and assisting with planning for a project to teach ICT technology to kids in rural areas of Cameroon.
Outreach for menstrual hygiene project to spread access and education to menstrual hygiene to Cameroonian girls who are at risk of missing school while on their period.
Coordinating and organizing US volunteers and collaborating with overseas volunteers.
Managing many aspects of the organization such as finances, marketing and maintaining relationships with partner organizations.
Java Android app design for an app used by mobile health workers to quickly look up information about patients' symptoms.
